transactions.subtitle: Shared expenses on web, iPhone, iPad and Android.
transactions.summary: Track shared expenses, approvals and balances across web and native mobile apps. The web app is available now; the iOS app is waiting for Apple review. Try the browser demo without an account.
transactions.oneLiner: Shared expenses and balances across web and mobile.
transactions.description: Transactions records shared expenses, requests, approvals, disputes and settlements between people. The native Expo/React Native clients for iPhone, iPad and Android share Firebase Authentication and Firestore records with the Next.js web app. CSV import/export and native file sharing help keep records portable. The web app is available now. iOS 1.0.0 (build 1), listed as Transactions: Shared Ledger, is waiting for Apple review with automatic release after approval. Android store publication is deferred. Transactions records obligations; it does not transfer money or connect to bank accounts.

better-workspace.description: Better Workspace helps turn ideas into projects and projects into a useful next step. Advanced Mac 1.0 connects real folders, portable plans, priorities, capture, work history and optional reviewed integrations. Its signed, notarized download includes the runtime for Apple silicon and Intel. The iPhone and iPad app is available on the App Store as version 1.0.1: keep a workspace offline and connect the optional advanced Mac for its files and integrations. Explore the browser demo, download advanced Mac, install the mobile app or view the public source.
